program_name: Foundation Certificate in Biological and Biomedical Sciences

fees.notes: Official international tuition for 2026 entry: RM37,371.36 for the full 1-year programme (RM35,256 base + 6% SST RM2,115.36). Source: https://www.ncl.ac.uk/numed/students/finance/tuition-fees/ (accessed 2026-09-18); see also https://www.ncl.ac.uk/numed/study-with-us/international-students/courses-and-fees/.

requirements.general: In order to enrol for the Foundation programme, students must have 5Bs in each of the following subjects at O-Level, SPM, IGCSE, Local High School Curriculum Grade 12 or equivalent: Biology and Chemistry and Physics and Mathematics or Additional Mathematics and another subject
